Word mode

Sit down, pass it around, find the liar.

Everyone sees the same secret word except the imposter, who gets one hint and has to fake the rest.

  1. 1
    Set it up Choose how many players, then how many imposters, then whether the imposter gets a hint. Then press START.
  2. 2
    Pass it around The box says who it goes to next. That player taps the arrow, holds the HOLD button down to see their card, lets go, and taps Next.
  3. 3
    One clue each The box picks who starts. Go around the circle, one word out loud. Then talk, then vote, then tap Reveal to see the answer.

Reading your card

Crew see the word. Imposters see IMPOSTER and a line that starts Hint: with a related word after it, never the answer. Turn the hint off in setup and the imposter gets only the category, which makes their job much harder.

The hint is there so you can bluff, which just means saying something that sounds right when you actually have no idea. It's not there to let you guess the word. If the word is Dog you might get collar, walk or loyal. Enough to say something that fits, never enough to know it's a dog.

Everyone can see the category, which is the sort of thing the word is, like Food or Animals. The box picks it at random, so there's nothing for you to choose. It isn't secret, and it stays up on the screen while you go around giving clues, so everybody knows what sort of thing they're talking about and a clue like cheese makes sense. That is also what gives the imposter a chance.

Why you hold the button

The card only shows while you hold the button. Let go and it hides, so you cannot leave it showing by accident. Before you hold it, the card itself tells you to.

Bluffing

Bluffing is what the imposter does for the whole round. You know the category and one related word and nothing else, so you have to sound like you know the word. Say something vague enough to get away with, but solid enough that nobody suspects you.

The whole game in one line

This one catches the crew as well. Too obvious and the imposter learns the word. Too vague and everyone thinks you're the imposter.

The vote

Talk it over, then point at once on three. Everyone points at the same moment so that nobody can hang back and just follow the crowd. Most votes is out. The device does not run the vote. Arguing about it's half the fun.

The last chance: if you vote the imposter out and they can still name the secret word, they steal the win. Agree before you start whether you're playing it that way, because that one is between you and not something the box decides.

Then settle it

Once you have voted, tap Reveal. The box has known the answer the whole time and this is where it tells you: the word, and exactly which players were lying. No arguing about who was actually the imposter.
